escalations.title: Handlebars RCE via ts-jest dependency chain — CVSS 9.8
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update ts-jest && npm audit
escalations.fix_verification: Confirm handlebars >= 4.7.9 in npm ls output; npm audit shows 0 critical

escalations.title: Protobufjs RCE in platform/orchestrator — CVSS 9.8
escalations.root: Google Cloud client library → protobufjs (vulnerable to RCE via .proto parsing)
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs && npm audit
escalations.fix_verification: Confirm protobufjs >= 7.5.5 in npm ls output; npm audit shows 0 critical

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search route not wired — DependencyPicker broken at runtime
p1_findings.detail: GET /api/search endpoint required by FR-dependency-search is not registered in Source/Backend/src/app.ts. Test file exists and traces FR but documents the route is missing. Feature completely non-functional at runtime.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q=<query> and register in app.ts. Test file specifies full contract.

p2_findings.title: inspector.config.yml excludes portal/ — 50+ FRs invisible to traceability gate
p2_findings.detail: source.dirs lists only ['Source/']. The portal/ directory has 30+ source files implementing FR-033..FR-089. Enforcer default run always targets self-judging-workflow (100% PASS) masking all portal gaps.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add portal/Backend/src/ and portal/Frontend/src/ to source.dirs. Add portal tests to test_dirs.

p2_findings.title: POST /api/work-items/:id/dependencies returns wrong response shape
p2_findings.detail: api-contracts.md specifies {data: WorkItem} (201). Implementation returns raw DependencyLink object.
p2_findings.recommendation: Return {data: updatedWorkItem} (201) from dependency add handler. Update test expectations.

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies status in api-contracts.md absent from WorkItemStatus enum
p2_findings.detail: WorkItemStatus enum has no PendingDependencies value. Dispatch route returns HTTP 400 instead of setting pending_dependencies state. Auto-advance cascade from pending_dependencies to approved is also unimplemented.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending_dependencies' to enum. Update VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS. Change dispatch logic to set status. Implement auto-advance in onItemResolved. Coordinate-first change (shared types + backend + frontend).

p2_findings.title: 7 plan files have unimplemented FRs not covered by inspector scan
p2_findings.detail: ~50 FRs across 7 plans target portal/ which is excluded from inspector scan. Most actionable: Plans/duplicate-deprecated-status (APPROVED) FR-DUP-06..FR-DUP-13 (8 FRs).
p2_findings.recommendation: Prioritise Plans/duplicate-deprecated-status (approved, bounded). Fix QO-002 first to make these visible to the enforcer.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — CVSS 7.5 — affects route parsing
p2_findings.detail: Vulnerable path-to-regexp version in portal/orchestrator and platform/orchestrator affects route parsing under adversarial input.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update in portal/orchestrator to pull path-to-regexp >= 8.x. Verify with npm audit.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions without explanation
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining why the exclusion is safe, or fix the hook to include the missing dependency.

p3_findings.title: /health endpoint has no spec traceability comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add FR-WF-014 to requirements.md and // Verifies: FR-WF-014 to app.ts:41, OR document as infrastructure-only.

p3_findings.title: 3 recently-added portal/ files lack Verifies: traceability
p3_findings.recommendation: Identify which spec these implement. Write spec first if none exists. Add // Verifies: FR-XXX comments.

p3_findings.title: UUID package 5 major versions behind (v9 in Backend/Portal vs v14 current)
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade uuid to >= 14.x. Note: major version bump — review API changes.

p3_findings.title: Vite/esbuild dev server vulnerabilities (multiple moderate CVEs)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update in frontend workspaces. Lower risk (dev server only) but include in maintenance PR.

p3_findings.title: PostCSS/brace-expansion moderate CVEs in Source/Frontend dev deps
p3_findings.recommendation: Include in dependency maintenance PR. npm update to resolve.

p3_findings.title: dockerode/gaxios transitive vulnerabilities in platform/orchestrator
p3_findings.recommendation: Monitor dockerode for patches. Include gaxios in npm update pass.

p4_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p4_findings.recommendation: Remove flat versions after confirming pages/ versions provide equivalent coverage.
